description:
The Term Loan Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of India to support the growth of small and medium enterprises in the country. 

This scheme is specifically implemented by the Gujarat State Khadi and Village Industries Board, abbreviated as GSKVN. 

The scheme was introduced in the year 2015. 

The primary objective of the Term Loan Scheme is to provide financial assistance to small and medium enterprises. 

The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth. 

It also seeks to enhance the production capacity of existing enterprises. 

The scheme targets the creation of job opportunities in rural and semi-urban areas. 

The specific goal is to provide loans to eligible entrepreneurs to establish or expand their businesses. 

The financial assistance under this scheme is provided in the form of term loans. 

The maximum loan amount available under the Term Loan Scheme is ₹25 lakh. 

The interest rate on the loans is set at 7 percent per annum. 

The repayment period for the loans is typically 5 to 7 years. 

The loan amount is disbursed in installments based on the progress of the project. 

The scheme also includes a provision for a moratorium period of 6 months. 

This moratorium allows entrepreneurs to stabilize their businesses before starting repayments. 

Eligibility criteria for the Term Loan Scheme include being a resident of Gujarat. 

Applicants must be aged between 18 and 55 years. 

The scheme is open to individuals as well as partnerships and private limited companies. 

The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹10 lakh. 

Educational qualifications are not strictly defined but having a basic understanding of business operations is beneficial. 

The application process for the Term Loan Scheme involves several steps. 

Interested applicants must first obtain the application form from the GSKVN office or the official website. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with a detailed project report. 

The project report should outline the business idea, market analysis, and financial projections. 

Additionally, applicants must provide identity proof, address proof, and income proof documents. 

A bank statement for the last six months is also required. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by a committee at GSKVN. 

The committee assesses the viability of the project and the applicant's credentials. 

If approved, the loan agreement is signed, and funds are disbursed. 

The disbursement is made in installments based on the project milestones. 

The first installment is typically released after the signing of the loan agreement. 

Subsequent installments are released after verifying the completion of specified project phases. 

The scheme is beneficial for various sectors including manufacturing, services, and agriculture. 

It has been instrumental in promoting local industries and reducing unemployment. 

The Term Loan Scheme has contributed to the establishment of numerous small enterprises across Gujarat. 

As of 2023, over 5,000 entrepreneurs have availed of financial assistance under this scheme. 

The total amount disbursed since its inception is approximately ₹1,200 crore. 

The scheme has also facilitated the creation of more than 25,000 jobs in the state. 

The implementing authority for the Term Loan Scheme is the Gujarat State Khadi and Village Industries Board. 

The board operates under the Department of Cottage and Small Scale Industries, Government of Gujarat. 

For more information, applicants can contact the GSKVN office directly. 

The contact number for the GSKVN office is 079-232-530-71. 

The official website of GSKVN provides additional resources and application forms. 

The website can be accessed at www.gskvn.gujarat.gov.in. 

The Term Loan Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to promote entrepreneurship. 

It aligns with the Make in India campaign launched in September 2014. 

This campaign aims to encourage domestic and foreign companies to manufacture in India. 

The Term Loan Scheme specifically supports the vision of self-reliant India. 

It empowers individuals to start their own businesses and contribute to the economy. 

The scheme also emphasizes sustainable development by promoting local resources. 

It encourages the use of traditional skills and crafts in business ventures. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to enhance its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Term Loan Scheme has been a crucial step in fostering a culture of entrepreneurship in Gujarat. 

It has inspired many individuals to take the leap into business ownership. 

The scheme continues to evolve to meet the changing needs of the economy. 

In conclusion, the Term Loan Scheme by GSKVN is a vital initiative for aspiring entrepreneurs in Gujarat. 

It provides essential financial support and resources to help them succeed. 

The scheme not only aids in individual growth but also contributes to the overall economic development of the state. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to create a robust ecosystem for small businesses. 

The Term Loan Scheme stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of India towards entrepreneurship and self-employment.
